## Maintenance Plan

`name`, `asset` (or `category` for a **template** — asset empty), `kind` preventive / inspection, `trigger` (Maintenance Trigger: catalog Recurring Pattern + meter threshold + whichever-first + lead days), `checklist` (the template, copied onto every generated work order), `estimatedHours`, `priority` (P1–P4), `assignTeamName`, `lastCompletedAt` / `lastCompletedMeter` (stamped only by **Complete Work Order**), `active`, `complianceWindowDays`.

Computed, never stored: `nextDueAt`, `nextDueMeter`, `isOverdue`, `dueLabel` — all through `planNext()` → `utils/recurrence.nextOccurrence`, the single source of rhythm math that the Maintenance Calendar, the PM generator and the Home runway also call.

### Consume
`import { MaintenancePlan, planNext, planTriggerData } from './maintenance-plan'`. Generate PM Work Orders iterates active plans and raises a Work Order when `planNext(plan).generateOn <= today + horizon`, keyed by `planDueKey(plan.id, dueDate)`.
